Exam Date & Time: 02-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Artificial Neural Network and Deep Learning [CSE-3271]  
Marks: 50                                                                           Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Differentiate between linear and non-linear activation functions used in deep learning  
  using suitable example.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      A 3-input and 2-output neural network has the weight values w11=0.6, w12=1.1,  
  w21=0.7, w22=0.5, w31=0.8, w32=0.2. It is given an input of [0.3, 0.7, 1.6]. What is  
  the output of the neural network if the binary step activation function is used by   (3)  
  assuming a threshold of 1.5. Also find the output if sigmoid function is used as  
  activation function.  
  
  C)      List out the steps of Memory based learning method in detail using K-nearest  
  neighbour classifier.                                                                    (5)  
  
2)           Apply Multilayer feedforward network for stock market prediction with the help of  
  architecture diagram depicting various layers and mention input features, type of  
  (5)  
  layers, activation function, learning algorithm and loss function.  
  A)  
  B)      List out the steps involved in learning process of Radial basis function with a block  
  diagram and process of determining the output weights.                                   (5)  
  
3)           Suppose for instance that the 2-dimensional input vector X is presented to the three-  
  neuron Kohonen network and W1, W2 and W3 are initial weight vectors. Apply and  
  find the winning neuron and updated weights:                                          (5)  
  $$A)      X = [0.52, 0.12], W1= [0.27, 0.81], W2 = [0.42, 0.70], W3 = [0.43, 0.21].$$  
  
  B)      Distinguish between Generator and Discriminator components using block diagram  
  in Generative Adversarial Networks using suitable data set.                              (5)  
  
4)           Implement a Convolutional neural network based model using phyton code for  
  classifying any image data set by using any pretrained model and print loss and  
  (5)  
  accuracy.  
  A)  
  B)      List out the different types of transfer learning models with suitable examples.         (5)  
5)           Differentiate between two Recurrent neural network (RNN) architectures RN-LSTM  
  and RNN-GRU using any suitable example and architecture diagram.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply Recurrent neural network with the help of architecture diagram depicting  
  various layers and mention input features, number of layers, activation function,        (5)  
  learning algorithm and loss function for sentiment analysis task which aims to

determine the sentiment or emotion expressed in a piece of text, such as positive,  
  negative, or neutral.  
  
  
-----End-----
